ith bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Open ing dat e Minimum qualifying criteria for LED product manufacturer/supplier: 1. The bidder must submit all relevant documents like CRS, BIS, TDS, LM79, LM80, IP, TTC, Photobiology, a nd NABL In-house Lab in its manufacturing plant. 2. All bidders are requested to upload all certificates such as warranty, Esc matrix, and toll-free no. that m ust have a valid date during the tender tenure. 9. For technical qualification, bidders must provide one LED floodlight as a sample. 10. Both the manufacturer and the supplied product must be registered in the UP PWD CAT AAA Sor; subm it documentary evidence. .
